app.title: F5-TTS Spanish Voice Synthesis
app.referenceText: Good morning. My name is María and I work as a Spanish teacher. Today we are going to learn about the importance of effective communication in the digital world. It is fascinating how technology has transformed the way we interact, allowing us to connect with people from all over the world in real time. However, it is also crucial to maintain a healthy balance between digital and face-to-face life.

apiDocs.title: API Documentation
apiDocs.subtitle: Complete technical reference for integrating F5-TTS voice synthesis into your applications.
apiDocs.gettingStartedDesc: To use the API you need a valid API Key. You can create one from the
apiDocs.authenticationDesc: All requests require authentication via an API Key sent in the Authorization header.
apiDocs.synthesizeDesc: Generates synthesized audio from a reference audio and text.
apiDocs.fieldRefAudio: Reference audio file (WAV, MP3, OGG, WebM). Max 15MB.
apiDocs.fieldRefText: Reference text (optional, can be sent empty).
apiDocs.queueStatusDesc: Check the current processing queue status.
apiDocs.isProcessing: Whether a request is currently being processed
apiDocs.rateLimitingDesc: The API has a limit of 5 requests per minute per API Key. Requests are processed sequentially, so if the queue is busy your request will wait its turn.
apiDocs.note1: The reference audio should be good quality for best results.
apiDocs.note2: Reference text is optional; if omitted it will be auto-detected.
apiDocs.note3: Generation time is approximately 20-30 seconds per request.
apiDocs.note4: Generated audio is returned in WAV format.
